description: This file defines a PHP controller class 'ViewMyClaimController' within the OrangeHRM system, specifically in the Claim plugin, responsible for handling the view logic for 'my claim' functionality. It extends an abstract Vue controller and sets up a component during the pre-render stage.

classes.name: ViewMyClaimController
classes.description: Controller class for viewing the user's claims, extending the base Vue controller and setting up the 'my-claim' component during pre-render.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Pre-render hook that initializes the 'my-claim' component and associates it with the controller.
